synopsis: Dark-fantasy realism 8k cinematic gladiator arena bout and Mortal Kombat-style finishing move. Inside the Stage 1 Common Colosseum at night, Bleed Hide (an armoured Common War Rhino) and Snarl Snapper (an ash-grey Common Dire Wolf) clash across three intense combat exchanges. On the final exchange, Snarl Snapper awakens its volcanic Ravager bloodline and executes the 'Hellfang Spine-Breaker' finishing move, corkscrew-slamming Bleed Hide into the shattered arena flagstones for the knockout victory.
